lines.station: Welcome to Heart Melody! Go straight ahead to explore the musical instruments and the hedge maze. Find the singing fountain in the middle of the maze. To reach the Melody World Garden islands, follow this raised, flower-lined path. I'll walk beside you, and you can keep moving while I talk.
lines.garden: Welcome to Heart Melody! First, find the Echo Berry grove beside the meadow entrance. Press Q, or A on your controller, and harvest the protected story allotment. Then visit all three seed planters. Choose any feeling or sound, and confirm each planting.
lines.rhythm: Your three seeds are planted! Now play the flower drums in this order: Leaf, Sun, then Droplet. Open Arrange the garden phrase, and confirm your answer. Then enter the Blight clearing. Step away from an attack, and press F, or X on your controller, when its shell is recovering. Clear both waves to awaken River Song.
lines.organ: The Feeling Garden is restored! Follow the connected root walk to the Waterfall Organ. Harvest the protected Dew Pears nearby, then interact with the organ and tune its three valves to the target numbers. You can explore the other gardens on foot while you restore their music in order.
lines.harp: The organ is singing! Next is the Hush Vine String Harp. Harvest the protected Sun Plums, then tune the five strings to match their target numbers. Use the instrument's listen and hint buttons whenever you need them.
lines.boat: Well done! Find the Rain Boat Call Bells and harvest the protected Bell Apples. Repeat the bell pattern shown by the activity to wake the boat. The connected root walk is also open if you would rather walk across.
lines.chimes: Next, restore the Harmony Bridge Chimes with protected Bell Apples. Play the three arches in order when the wind marker says OPEN. Your completed instruments stay restored.
lines.warning: Now follow the Fear Warning Bell Path. Harvest the protected Moon Melons, then answer Leaf, Sun, and Droplet. Wait for QUIET before each step. Your completed steps survive a retry.
lines.loom: The valley has found its voices! At the Heart Song Loom, bring the recovered drum, water, harp, and chime motifs together. Listen to the tracks before adding them to your song.
lines.anchors: Let's help the Silent Conductor. Approach each of the three beat anchors while the shell is recovering, and complete its short rhythm, pitch, or direction lesson. Keep outside the warning ripple during an attack.
lines.orchestra: One final song! Bring the six protected story fruits to the Harmony Fruit Orchestra: Echo Berry, Sun Plum, Dew Pear, Bell Apple, Moon Melon, and Harmony Fig. Place them in that order, then conduct North, East, South, and West on the open beats.
lines.complete: You restored Heart Melody! Visit the Jewel Sanctuary for your Harmony Jewel and shield. All the flowers and musical activities remain available to replay. The return gate takes us back to the Castle, and I'll stay beside you.
lines.free_play: You can play flowers from the front, back, or either side. Press Q, or A, when Play flower appears. Visit the Fruit Marimba, Vine Harp, Hanging Bell Garden, and Garden Ensemble for more music. The Valley map shows your next objective, fruit locations, hints, and crafting. Open Help to hear my current guidance again.

generation.method: Local reference-conditioned narration using the existing approved opening recording; implicit audio watermark retained.
